title: RF-1 Geohazard Screening Report

executiveSummary.text: Screening results catalogued 360,000 analysis-grid pixels over the AOI, with 40.8961% Low, 22.2258% Moderate, 33.0344% High, and 3.8436% Extreme risk bands. The highest-ranked hotspots are all Extreme and are observed primarily in built-up areas over ALBION, CARVOLTH, HAZELWOOD, SCAT, CLOVERDALE, TRIGGS, and GRAVEL PIT soil units. A key data gap is that Sentinel-1 GRD source coverage is unavailable for this run, and soil survey coverage does not extend to 6.977% of the grid.

keyFindings.statement: The analysis grid contains 360,000 pixels across 36.0 km2.
Risk band extent is catalogued as 40.8961% Low, 22.2258% Moderate, 33.0344% High, and 3.8436% Extreme.
The 25 listed hotspots are all catalogued as Extreme with riskScore 25.
Sentinel-1 GRD input coverage is unavailable for this run.
Soil survey polygons mapped 93.023% of the analysis grid, leaving 6.977% without that coverage.

sections.heading: Methodology
sections.body: This report is a screening summary for RF-1 using the supplied formula risk_score = s_rating * c_rating and the provided band definitions for Low, Moderate, High, and Extreme. The report explains only deterministic values catalogued in the run evidence and does not infer missing measurements or recalculate scores.

sections.heading: Source coverage
sections.body: Source coverage is catalogued as available for ALOS PALSAR mosaic STAC items, BC bedrock geology, BC geological fault lines, BC quaternary / surficial geology, BC SIFT soil project boundaries, BC soil survey polygons, Copernicus DEM GLO-30, ESA WorldCover, Harmonized global biomass, Esri 10 m land use / land cover, a single-collection parameterised demo table, Sentinel-1 RTC radar STAC items, and Sentinel-2 L2A optical STAC items. Sentinel-1 GRD radar STAC items are unavailable. Soil survey coverage includes 334,883 of 360,000 pixels, or 93.023%, so 6.977% of the analysis grid lacks that surveyed-soil coverage.

sections.heading: Risk distribution
sections.body: The risk band distribution over the 360,000-pixel analysis grid is catalogued as Low at 147,226 pixels, Moderate at 80,013 pixels, High at 118,924 pixels, and Extreme at 13,837 pixels. In percent terms, those bands are 40.8961%, 22.2258%, 33.0344%, and 3.8436%, respectively.

limitations.text: Screening-level output. RF-1 ratings use availability-weighted proxies over public data and are not a substitute for site investigation or engineering assessment.
Susceptibility blends indirect remote-sensing proxies with surveyed soil polygons; only the soil survey is direct ground truth.
Sentinel-1 GRD source coverage is unavailable for this run.
Soil survey polygons cover 93.023% of the analysis grid; coverage is not present for the remaining 6.977%.

dataGaps.text: Sentinel-1 GRD radar STAC items could not be read, so that source coverage question is unanswered for this run beyond the unavailable status.

The provided evidence does not include hotspot-specific soil survey polygon identifiers, geology names, or fault attributes beyond nearestFaultKm, so no additional hotspot attribution can be reported.

disclaimer: This output is an automated screening summary for demonstration purposes. It is not a site investigation, hazard certification, engineering design, or substitute for review by qualified geotechnical and geospatial professionals using authoritative local data.
